tabs.tab_title: Which path is right for me?
tabs.tab_content: It comes down to how much of the work you want to do yourself. If you like to learn and implement, start with the Community. If you want an expert working through your plan with you, choose coaching. If you want it done for you with results guaranteed, book a strategy call. The Framework Quiz will also recommend a path based on your score.

tabs.tab_title: What happens if I cancel my Community membership?
tabs.tab_content: [CONFIRM] You keep access through the end of your billing period. After that, access to the course, Blueprint and weekly content ends, and if you rejoin later it will be at the current rate, not your founding rate.

tabs.tab_title: Will my Community price go up?
tabs.tab_content: Not while you stay a member. The rate you join at is locked in. The price goes up for new members as the Community grows.

tabs.tab_title: Is the Community included with coaching?
tabs.tab_content: No. Coaching is 1:1 time built entirely around your business, so it works on its own. Coaching clients can add the Community at 50% off if they want the course, Blueprint and weekly content too.

tabs.tab_title: What is the difference between a webinar and a workshop?
tabs.tab_content: Webinars are live trainings where you watch and learn, and they are included with the Community. Workshops are hands-on: you work on your own business with our team guiding you, and you leave with something finished.
Yes. Plenty of owners start in the Community, add coaching when they want more guidance, and move to a partnership when they are ready to hand it off.
